description_en: Updates the credentials of ingest endpoints associated with a live package channel
description_zh: 实时打包服务API，用于刷新指定频道的输入端点密钥
kebab_example: aliyun ice update-live-package-channel-credentials --group-name group-1 --channel-name channel-1 --rotate-credentials 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLivePackageChannelCredentials

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to update the credentials. 1: updates the credentials of endpoint 1. 2: updates the credentials of endpoint 2. 3: updates the credentials of endpoints 1 and 2
parameters.help_zh: 是否刷新密钥, 1: 刷新端点1密钥，2: 刷新端点2密钥，3: 刷新端点1&2密钥
parameters.name: rotate_credentials
